title: Captured loop fuel configuration
statement: For Boolean machines $body$ and $F$, an input string $x$, and a configuration $c$ of $F$ on $x$, define a configuration of $body.k+1+(1+F.k)+1$ work tapes whose state space is $F.State\oplus((\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\times(body.State\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}))\oplus Fin(14))$. It is obtained by capturing the loop-fuel configuration associated with $c$, using the left state summand and the element $0$ of the final $Fin(14)$ summand.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the capture operation or the loop-fuel configuration, so their detailed contents cannot be specified faithfully.
